# FatCat Property Management

> FatCat PM manages residential properties for out-of-state owners in Chicago and the Midwest. Owners get a portal with their properties, weekly reports, and a maintenance ticket system. Owner login: magic-link (no password). Admin login: email in the admin_emails table.

## Key URLs
- Marketing site: https://fatcatpm.com
- Owner portal: https://portal-fatcatpm.vercel.app
- Owner login: https://portal-fatcatpm.vercel.app/ (magic link)
- Admin dashboard: https://portal-fatcatpm.vercel.app/admin

## What this is
- Property management company, residential only
- Weekly owner reports with rent/expense totals and work orders
- Photo attachments on reports via Supabase storage
- Email digest to owner on every new report (via Resend)
- 4-column kanban for maintenance tickets (open, in_progress, resolved, cancelled)
- Out-of-state referral pipeline for partner brokers

## Tech
- Next.js 14 on Vercel
- Supabase (auth, Postgres, storage)
- Resend for owner emails
- Stripe NOT used here (Stripe is on the dancruzhomes.com grader)

## Related
- Parent: https://fatcatam.com (FatCat Asset Management)
- Sister: https://dancruzhomes.com (Dan Cruz Homes)
